metaData.originalTitle: A Smarter Google AI Edge Gallery: MCP integration， notifications， and session continuity
metaData.title: A Smarter Google AI Edge Gallery: MCP integration， notifications， and session continuity
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Google AI Edge Gallery now supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP), local notification reminders, and persistent chat history, enabling developers to build connected, proactive, and persistent on-device agentic experiences with Gemma 4.
metaData.summary: This article announces significant updates to the Google AI Edge Gallery app, a showcase for on-device AI. The key new features are threefold. First, experimental support for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) over Streamable HTTP, allowing the on-device Gemma 4 model to dynamically import tool definitions and coordinate complex tasks across external data sources like Google Workspace and Google Maps, with all reasoning happening locally. Second, a new 'Schedule Notification' skill enables proactive, automated routines, such as daily mood tracking or calendar briefings, triggered by local notifications. Third, the app now supports persistent chat history using the fast prefill capability of the LiteRT-LM backend, allowing sessions to resume almost instantly with full context. The article also highlights the open-source community's contributions and provides developer tips for optimizing MCP tool descriptions for on-device models.

mainPoints.point: Google AI Edge Gallery adds experimental support for the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
mainPoints.explanation: By registering an MCP URL, the app dynamically imports tool definitions, allowing the on-device Gemma 4 model to reason and call external tools like Google Workspace or Google Maps, with all decision-making happening locally on the phone.

mainPoints.point: New 'Schedule Notification' skill enables proactive, automated routines.
mainPoints.explanation: Users can set up local notifications for tasks like mood tracking or daily learning. Tapping the notification opens the app directly to the relevant tool, enabling a proactive agentic experience beyond reactive prompting.

mainPoints.point: Persistent chat history is now supported for session continuity.
mainPoints.explanation: Using the fast prefill capability of the LiteRT-LM backend, the app can restore long session contexts almost instantly, allowing users to resume conversations with full state, including text, images, and audio.

keyQuotes: By supporting the open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP), local notification reminders, and chat history, we are making the app a more useful place to experience and chat with models locally.
The reasoning and decision-making then happen entirely on your phone.
On modern phone GPUs, prefill speeds can exceed 3,000 tokens per second, allowing the model to restore long session contexts almost instantly.
Because on-device models operate within a smaller context window than large server-side models, we recommend keeping your MCP tool descriptions short.
